suggest.doctrine/doctrine-bundle: If you want to use the DoctrineRegistry (default engine).
suggest.snc/redis-bundle: One way to provide a redis client service for the Redis engine.
suggest.predis/predis: A redis client usable as redis.client_service for the Redis engine.
suggest.symfony/form: Required for the built-in CRUD controllers (ui.enabled).
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: Required for the built-in CRUD controllers (ui.enabled).
suggest.symfony/security-csrf: Required for CSRF protection of the built-in CRUD controllers (ui.enabled).
suggest.symfony/security-core: Required for access control of the built-in CRUD controllers (ui.enabled).
suggest.symfony/validator: Required to validate the entities (NotBlank/Length/UniqueEntity constraints).
suggest.symfony/doctrine-bridge: Provides the UniqueEntity constraint used by the entities.
